notes.title: Disaster Blaster demo update v0.5.2 🔥 Just in time for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, actual and wannabe disaster makers! 🌍💥

To kick off Steam Next Fest (Feb 24 – Mar 3), we’ve launched a major Disaster Blaster demo update packed with exciting new content! Check out what’s waiting for you:

🪐 Planet lore pages 
You can now study the planets and uncover their lore! Dive deeper into the universe of Disaster Blaster and discover the secrets behind each world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/1436305452c096fe0d00bfbf35f112190aed6eda.gif

👾 New playable characters 
Welcome Tuutshak and No-med to the chaos! Who will be your favorite?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/809a51de53cf035e7145b23e385e7917d8ff833c.gif

💀 Hard mode added 
The demo now includes a hard mode for its planet, and in the full game, every planet will have its own! 

🏆 Brand-new leaderboards 
Now you can see the scores and blaster builds used by other players! A great way to discover new playstyles and experiment with different strategies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/914d9f698b61d915949d4cfc22652e4340489910.gif

🛠️ Minor bug fixes
We’ve tackled various minor bugs to keep your gameplay as smooth as possible.

📢 Follow the Steam Next Fest and don’t miss our livestream! Tune in to see Disaster Blaster in action, chat with us, and get an exclusive look at the chaos! 

[hr][/hr]

Follow Disaster Blaster and add it to your wishlist to get the latest updates, exclusive news, and all the exciting development progress straight to your feed! And remember to share your feedback through the in-game form button to help us improve! 💬✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194600/Disaster_Blaster/

Thanks for playing and for all your feedback, more updates are on the way! 🔥

Happy Disasters! ❤️

notes.title: Disaster Blaster demo update v0.4.0 💡 New Eureka mechanic!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, actual and wannabe disaster makers! 🌍💥

We’re excited to bring you version 0.4.0 of the demo with some fresh tweaks and improvements.

[previewyoutube=kIxG8i6cU8s;full][/previewyoutube]


New Eureka mechanic 💡
We've introduced the Eureka button, a new strategic option that becomes available once you reach a certain number of points during the game. As brilliant scientists, you’ll experience a true stroke of genius, allowing you to reroll your upgrade choices once per match. Instead of the usual selection, you'll get three fresh card options, giving you a better chance to optimize your blaster upgrades. Use it wisely to push your experiments to the next level!


New soundtracks added 🎶 
This update also brings brand-new tracks to enhance the game’s atmosphere, just like the one used in the trailer above!


Minor bug fixes
We’ve tackled various minor bugs to keep your gameplay as smooth as possible.

notes.title: Disaster Blaster demo update v0.3.0 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, actual and wannabe disaster makers! 🌍💥

We’re excited to bring you version 0.3.0 of the demo with some fresh tweaks and improvements.

[previewyoutube=YecYbXpXQYQ;full][/previewyoutube]


Completely redesigned HUD
We’ve completely reworked the blaster design, redesigned the card icons, and transformed everything into pixel art for a more cohesive and visually appealing experience. We hope you like it! 😄


Implemented leveling system
The leveling system increases the amount of resources you earn during matches, allowing you to unlock new planets, characters, and cards. This effect will be more impactful in the full version of the game.


Added windowed mode
You can now choose to play in windowed mode, giving you more flexibility in how you interact with the game, especially for multitasking or streamers. 


Implemented tutorial
We’ve added helpful tips that guide players through the first match, teaching them the basic strategies to succeed and enjoy the game right from the start.


Minor bug fixes
We’ve tackled various minor bugs to keep your gameplay as smooth as possible.

notes.title: Disaster Blaster demo update v0.1.11 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, actual and wannabe disaster makers! 🌍💥

We’re excited to bring you version 0.1.11 of the demo with some fresh tweaks and improvements.

[previewyoutube=uYrcHL6srGM;full][/previewyoutube]

New key art
We finally have new key art for Disaster Blaster, featuring Neil  alongside other aliens who will appear in the full version, and plenty of destruction!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/1d5d49a3539c9653e4577fa4d975fbe5018c722b.png


A fresh look for Neil 
With the creation of the new key art, we’ve given our humanoid alien Neil  a brand-new look. His in-game sprite has also been updated to match. What do you think of the redesign?


Four new cards
We’ve added four new cards to the demo, giving you even more ways to create incredible combos:


 A card that teleports bullets leaving the screen to the opposite side.
 A card that fires an extra bullet from a random position at the top of the screen.
 A card that multiplies bullet damage by the maximum number of cards of the same type in the blaster.
 A card that splits a bullet into fragments that deal damage when it hits a target.



Minor bug fixes
We’ve tackled various minor bugs to keep your gameplay as smooth as possible.
